description:
This trail starts close to the Alpine.

Once at the Bus walk north along the treeline and look for the main trail.

This trail is maintained by the Wolverine Nordic & Mountain Society.

Wolverine Nordic & Mountain Society

Photos and Maps courtesy of the WNMS.
directions:
From Tumbler Ridge drive 7.3 Km on Hwy 29N towards Chetwynd. Turn left (West) onto the Wolverine FSR. Drive to the Coal Mine site. Once at the Coal Mine site sign-in at the security gate, where they will supply you with a radio and escort you through the mine site to the Perry Creek FSR.

Once throught the Coal Mine Site and back on the Perry Creek FSR, drive another 7.3 keeping left till you reach the trailhead/emergency warming shelter/yellow bus.
title: Mount Reesor
